basics.name: Federico Failla
basics.label: Software Engineer | Java | Backend
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience in software development, with extensive experience building Java-based web applications and backend services across enterprise, financial, tax, gaming, and reservation domains. Experienced with Java 7–17, Spring/Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, PostgreSQL, messaging, Docker and CI/CD. In recent years, focused on designing and evolving backend services, translating business requirements into technical solutions, improving existing systems, and collaborating across Product, QA and engineering teams.

work.name: Distillery
work.summary: Backend and full-stack development within a microservices-based environment for a nationwide U.S. online booking and work-order platform. Collaborate with Product, QA, BI and engineering teams across the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and refinement through implementation, testing, deployment and production support.
responsibilities: Translate business requirements into technical solutions and actionable Jira stories, participating in refinement sessions and defining acceptance criteria and implementation considerations.

Design and evolve RESTful APIs and backend service integrations consumed by frontend applications and other services, considering service boundaries, contract compatibility, validation, error handling and maintainability.
Develop and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot within a microservices architecture.
Investigate and improve existing systems, including application behavior, persistence performance, database interactions and service integrations.
Collaborate with Product, QA and BI teams to clarify requirements, troubleshoot issues and deliver production-ready solutions.
Participate in code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD workflows and production deployments.
achievements: Contributed to the migration of backend services from Java 11 to Java 17, addressing compatibility, dependency and build/runtime changes while maintaining application behavior.
Implemented an incremental VCDB ETL process using a Dockerized MySQL environment, processing the full reference dataset and subsequent monthly changes to support automotive data integration.
Optimized backend availability functionality by investigating and addressing inefficient database access patterns, including N+1 query behavior.
Contributed to business-rule enhancements involving multiple responsible parties within repair-order workflows.
Implemented and evolved database-backed business rules for pricing and fee configuration, including entitlement-based fee exclusions.
Contributed to authentication and authorization integrations using Microsoft Entra ID and OAuth-based flows.
Improved document access and storage security by addressing access patterns around S3-hosted resources.
Contributed to the migration of application logging and observability from Kibana-based infrastructure toward CloudWatch and subsequent monitoring improvements.
Worked within a trunk-based development approach, contributing to CI/CD and continuous integration practices.
